method: Independent brute-force barycentric containment against every supplied original NOAA triangle, without the preparer Matplotlib triangle finder. Native signed face fluxes independently reconstructed in frozen solver order for discharge weights. Native scalar T interpolated from original source node values; no nearest-neighbor filling across shoreline.
scientific_interpretation: 109 positive-inflow cells are directly source-supported. The one uncovered shoreline inflow uses the contemporaneous covered-inflow discharge-weighted mean, an explicitly documented estimate affecting 0.04445% of total inflow. This does not establish observed or depth-uniform river temperature.
